system.description:
At Level 3 you can take off vertically from a standstill if unencumbered, or carry up to 50 pounds with a running start, reaching a maximum speed of 45 mph. At Level 4 you can take off vertically while carrying up to 50 pounds, or up to 100 pounds with a running takeoff, reaching 60 mph.

A Gargoyle with Level 3 Flight can always declare Fair Escape outdoors or beside an unobstructed window large enough to pass through (even closed, since a Gargoyle can simply smash it), and doing so from well above ground level (a skyscraper, a tall hill, several floors up) requires only a single level of Flight to glide to safety. A Gargoyle with at least Basic Celerity can declare Fair Escape at only Level 2 by achieving a fast running takeoff. Ranged attackers still get one attack as the Gargoyle departs, and pursuers with equal or greater Flight may keep attacking as long as they keep pace.
